verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents self-hosting the engine as a single dependency-free binary. It can be installed via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT or source, and official Docker images and Helm charts are provided; community users report easy self-hosted deployments, including k8s and an 80M-document box. The 'same features as hosted' part is not established: no documentation asserts feature parity, and a community report says replication/high availability is not in the free tier, while clusterization HA is advertised on the Cloud page. Missing for 10: documented feature parity with Meilisearch Cloud, self-hosted replication/HA clustering, and confirmation that Cloud-marketed features such as analytics, personalization and dynamic search rules are available self-hosted.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the full engine — same features as the hosted product — on my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
Install Meilisearch locally on Linux, macOS, or Windows using cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or from source.
Helm charts for deploying Meilisearch on Kubernetes.
Official Meilisearch Docker images for easy deployment and development.
